cohort: The study participants consisted of 1808 women with prior gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from 19 centres across Bangladesh, India, and Sri Lanka.
finding: A high incidence of postpartum diabetes (17.1%) was found in women with prior GDM in South Asia, with higher age, lower education status, higher prior pregnancy count, prior history of GDM, family history of DM, and postpartum overweight/obese status being significant risk factors, and notable variation in incidence rates observed between countries.
